title: Replace hand-rolled ==/hashCode in TrackBlueprint's value objects with @freezed
rule: Naming/placement/invariants — never hand-write ==/hashCode for data classes
why: coding-standards.md is explicit: hand-rolled equality drifts from the fields and silently breaks rebuild-skipping. AddTrackDraft's hand-rolled == (track_blueprint_draft_repository.dart:66-73) proves it: it omits scopeSelectionsJson and studyDays from both == and hashCode, so two drafts differing only in scope or study-days compare equal; its own test (track_blueprint_draft_repository_impl_test.dart:95-113) only exercises equality on navStepIndex/curriculumKey/programId and never asserts inequality on the omitted fields, so the gap is untested. track_blueprint.dart repeats the same hand-rolled pattern across 6 classes and add_track_result.dart's BulkMarkIntent makes 8 sites total, even though the codebase already has a working @freezed sealed-union convention elsewhere (goal_entity.dart, sync_status.dart, restore_status.dart). Two of the three files are currently dead code (see the migration-trio finding), which caps today's practical blast radius, but the pattern remains a trap for anyone who revives them or copies the style into new code.
recommendation: Convert TrackBlueprint's value objects and AddTrackDraft to @freezed sealed classes/records; add a test asserting inequality on the currently-omitted fields before/while converting.
acceptance_criteria: track_blueprint.dart and track_blueprint_draft_repository.dart's value types are @freezed with generated ==/hashCode
A test asserts two AddTrackDraft/TrackBlueprint instances differing only in a previously-omitted field are NOT equal

corrections: Stronger than claimed: TrackBlueprint's own ==/hashCode (track_blueprint.dart:314-333, evidence already cited) has the identical omission bug (drops studyDays AND scopeSelections), not just AddTrackDraft's — finding under-states rather than over-states its case.
